definitions.deterministic_ids: marker ids are a deterministic sequence in this harness; production ids are random, so real runs vary by a few tokens per rewrite
definitions.input_context_tokens: sum over turns of every visible tool-result token so far; the system prompt and user text are excluded because they are identical across modes and are not what SUTRA controls
definitions.tool_calls: fixed by the recorded workload; identical across modes
definitions.cost: unavailable: no provider call, no authoritative usage or price
definitions.policy_behaviour: not modelled: the same tool sequence is replayed in every mode
